title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Introducing plugins for Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint will gain plugins to enhance capabilities with specialized skills and connectors, improving presentation workflows. Rollout starts mid-November 2026 worldwide across Windows, Mac, and web. Admins should review and manage plugin access; no compliance issues identified.
body:
[What and why]

We are introducing plugins for Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint to extend Copilot's capabilities with new skills and connectors. Plugins bring specialized capabilities and information from connected services into presentation workflows, helping users create and refine presentations with content relevant to their work.

[Rollout schedule]

- Frontier (Worldwide): Rollout is anticipated to begin in mid-November 2026 and complete by late November 2026.- General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout is anticipated to begin in late November 2026 and complete by the end of November 2026.Note: This rollout schedule is subject to change. We will update this post with a confirmed rollout schedule.

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Users of Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint who have access to plugins.Platforms and services

- PowerPoint for Windows- PowerPoint for Mac- PowerPoint for the web- Microsoft 365 CopilotWhat will happen

- Users will be able to discover and use plugins available to them in Copilot within PowerPoint.- Plugins will extend Copilot's capabilities with specialized skills and connectors.- Users will be able to incorporate capabilities and information from connected services into their presentation workflows.[Action required and recommendations]

We recommend that you review available plugins and manage access for your organization in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
bodyHtml:
[What and why]

We are introducing plugins for Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint to extend Copilot's capabilities with new skills and connectors. Plugins bring specialized capabilities and information from connected services into presentation workflows, helping users create and refine presentations with content relevant to their work.

[Rollout schedule]

  • Frontier (Worldwide): Rollout is anticipated to begin in mid-November 2026 and complete by late November 2026.
  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout is anticipated to begin in late November 2026 and complete by the end of November 2026.

Note: This rollout schedule is subject to change. We will update this post with a confirmed rollout schedule.

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

  • Users of Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint who have access to plugins.

Platforms and services

  • PowerPoint for Windows
  • PowerPoint for Mac
  • PowerPoint for the web
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot

What will happen

  • Users will be able to discover and use plugins available to them in Copilot within PowerPoint.
  • Plugins will extend Copilot's capabilities with specialized skills and connectors.
  • Users will be able to incorporate capabilities and information from connected services into their presentation workflows.

[Action required and recommendations]

We recommend that you review available plugins and manage access for your organization in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
